# openmetadata_notification_template (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata notification template by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_notification_template" "asset_created" {
  fully_qualified_name = "asset-created-email"
}

output "asset_created_template_body" {
  value = data.openmetadata_notification_template.asset_created.template_body
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Notification template fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Notification template UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `is_modified_from_default` (Boolean) Whether the template differs from the OpenMetadata built-in default.
- `name` (String) Template name.
- `template_body` (String) Jinja template for the notification body.
- `template_subject` (String) Jinja template for the notification subject.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
